title: 80 days of building an Age of Sail RPG with AI – 3D characters, pirate AI, and alternate history quests
author: Novel_Cucumber_1588
selftext:
Hey everyone! I'm building a 3D sailing RPG in Godot, using AI extensively as a solo developer in my spare time.

Here's what I've been working on recently:

* **AI-generated 3D characters:** Tried Hyper3D (Rodin) because the first month was only $1. Facial geometry and textures were a bit disappointing, but automatic body rigging worked surprisingly well with Mixamo animations. Creating decent 3D characters has been one of the biggest challenges so far, and I'm still far from happy with the current quality, but I'm hoping Tripo will give me better results.
* **Pirate encounters:** Implemented pirates that detect and pursue merchant ships based on weather and visibility. Players can escape by sailing toward naval patrols. Unfortunately, my pirates are currently a little too fast.
* **AI-assisted quest writing:** Expanded historical quests and discoveries, including alternate-history storylines. Using AI to brainstorm historical scenarios and branching narratives has been surprisingly fun.

There's still a long way to go, but thanks to AI, I'm able to work on a project like this in my spare time after work, and I'm genuinely enjoying the process.

Good luck to everyone out there building games with AI.
